name: HC29b: Total Tested
description:
Number of eligible active ART patients whose most recent viral load test as of the end of the reporting period occurred during the preceding 12 months.
The patient must meet HC29a eligibility criteria, and the most recent qualifying VL episode on or before :endDate must have occurred within the previous 12 months. A VL result can establish that testing occurred even where the original order is absent, while an order without specimen or result evidence is not considered sufficient.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson:
{
  "version": 1,
  "patientIdColumn": "patient_id",
  "populationQuery": {
    "extractFrom": "sqlTemplate"
  },
  "supportsRedisaggregation": true,
  "redisaggregationStrategy": "population-extraction",
  "themeIndependent": true,
  "dataSources": [
    "mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen",
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary",
    "mamba_fact_viral_load_episode"
  ],
  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT r.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
WHERE r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL

  /* Patient has reached routine VL eligibility */
  AND DATE_ADD(r.art_start_date, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) <= :endDate

  /* HIV patient */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
      WHERE s.patient_id = r.patient_id
  )

  /* Active on ART */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = r.patient_id
        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  )

  /* Most recent actual VL test occurred within past 12 months */
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
      WHERE v.patient_id = r.patient_id

        AND COALESCE(
              v.sample_collection_date,
              v.viral_load_clinical_date,
              v.laboratory_result_date,
              v.order_date
            ) >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 12 MONTH)

        AND COALESCE(
              v.sample_collection_date,
              v.viral_load_clinical_date,
              v.laboratory_result_date,
              v.order_date
            ) < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

        /* Evidence that testing actually occurred */
        AND (
            v.sample_collection_date IS NOT NULL
            OR v.viral_load_clinical_date IS NOT NULL
            OR v.laboratory_result_date IS NOT NULL
            OR v.result_status = 'VALID'
        )

        /* Must be the patient's most recent actual VL */
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v2
            WHERE v2.patient_id = v.patient_id

              AND (
                  v2.sample_collection_date IS NOT NULL
                  OR v2.viral_load_clinical_date IS NOT NULL
                  OR v2.laboratory_result_date IS NOT NULL
                  OR v2.result_status = 'VALID'
              )

              AND COALESCE(
                    v2.sample_collection_date,
                    v2.viral_load_clinical_date,
                    v2.laboratory_result_date,
                    v2.order_date
                  ) <= :endDate

              AND COALESCE(
                    v2.sample_collection_date,
                    v2.viral_load_clinical_date,
                    v2.laboratory_result_date,
                    v2.order_date
                  ) >
                  COALESCE(
                    v.sample_collection_date,
                    v.viral_load_clinical_date,
                    v.laboratory_result_date,
                    v.order_date
                  )
        )
  );",
